description: E0b-2. A headless fragment pass (gles/EncodedYuvPass, JNI in jni_encoded_yuv.cpp, NativeSource.jniEncodedYuvPassHeadless) that reads the decoded Y plane and the interleaved CbCr plane as integer textures (R8UI/RG8UI or R16UI/RG16UI, row stride via UNPACK_ROW_LENGTH) and does exactly the first stage of rawedit::developEncoded: YCbCr to RGB with the frame's matrix and range, the transfer decode (Mi-Log, Rec.709, sRGB, linear), the BT.2020 to Rec.709 matrix taken from core's own gamutToGamut, WB gains times exposure, writing linear RGBA32F. EncodedColorSpec's ordinals are the only colour decision. Not wired to export or preview yet (E0b-3/E0b-4). New instrumentation test EncodedYuvPassParityTest runs nine cases (8-bit NV12 and P010, padded strides, every matrix/range/transfer/primaries incl. the owner's Mi-Log profile, plus exposure and temp/tint) against the CPU oracle through NativeEncode
